title: Ui Context Menu Suppress Default
description: All UI elements can have a special context menu. When no context menu is registered, nothing happens (not even the browser context menu showing).
summary: Updated `ContextMenu` so right-click always calls `preventDefault()` on the host; the Radix menu opens only when `items` is non-empty. Previously an empty `items` prop passed children through unchanged and the browser context menu still appeared. Added vitest coverage for the empty-items suppress path and the registered-menu open path.
